title: SkillCT: A Multidimensional Benchmark and Execution-Free Baseline for Agent Skill Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.38147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills package instructions, scripts, and resources for specialized tasks and are increasingly distributed through public Web repositories. However, existing skill benchmarks primarily focus on downstream task execution, insufficiently assessing specification quality, behavioral robustness, semantic alignment, and responsibility boundaries. Their reliance on task-specific tools, environments, and repeated executions limits scalability and pre-deployment assessment. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillCT, a benchmark that broadens skill assessment from downstream utility to a multidimensional characterization of skill quality. translated_title: SkillCT：面向智能体技能评估的多维度基准与免执行基线方法
translated_abstract: 智能体技能将专用任务的指令、脚本和资源打包在一起，并越来越多地通过公共网络仓库进行分发。然而，现有的技能基准主要关注下游任务执行，对规范质量、行为鲁棒性、语义对齐和责任边界的评估不足。它们对任务特定工具、环境和重复执行的依赖限制了可扩展性和部署前评估。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SkillCT，一个将技能评估从下游实用性拓展至技能质量多维表征的基准。SkillCT从三个方面的九个互补维度对技能进行评估：静态评估，捕捉技能规范的内在属性；动态评估，衡量所诱导的行为在不同骨干模型和请求变化下是否保持稳定；以及行为与人类认知相关的评估维度（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了SkillCT基准，将智能体技能评估从单纯的下游任务执行拓展为涵盖静态、动态等三个方面的九个维度的多维质量表征，并提供免执行的评估基线，解决了现有基准依赖特定工具与重复执行、难以扩展且无法进行部署前评估的问题。
en_tdlr: SkillCT introduces a multidimensional benchmark and an execution-free baseline that broadens agent skill assessment from downstream task utility to a nine-dimension, three-aspect characterization of skill quality, overcoming the scalability and pre-deployment limitations of execution-dependent benchmarks.
